# VestIntel - AI-Powered Stock Intelligence Platform

## Project Overview
Full-stack SaaS application for stock market analysis and portfolio management.

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, TailwindCSS, ShadCN UI, Recharts
- **Backend**: FastAPI (Python), PostgreSQL, Redis
- **APIs**: Alpha Vantage, Finnhub, Yahoo Finance
